text:
Maya (runtime): I'm claiming the small-night slot tonight 21:00 UTC for a lightweight runtime push. Plan: kernel v2.11 + quant-profile alpha-3. Need a smoke owner, rollback readiness confirmation, and a quick kv-cache note. No infra changes. Minimal rollout (canary -> widen).

Kevin: I can be smoke owner. I'll run latency + correctness passes. Are we toggling `prefetch_attention=true` with this kernel? Also what's the canary size?

Maya (runtime): yes prefetched attention flag will be enabled in the new kernel by default. Canary = 10% slab. We'll widen in 3 steps (10 -> 40 -> 100) with 10m observation windows.

Anita: Rollback prepared. Latest stable image: `engine-2.10.4`. Rollback manifest: `s3://rw-inference/rollbacks/engine-2.10.4/manifest.json`.
Rollback command (ops):
```
rwictl deploy --manifest s3://rw-inference/rollbacks/engine-2.10.4/manifest.json --force --reason "quick rollback"
```
Make sure you have `--no-wait` cleared if you want to watch progress.

Samir: KV cache note: changing quant profile may alter kv key shapes slightly. Recommend flush of recent prefixes post-canary if hit rates degrade. Command to flush prefixes we use: `rwictl cache flush --prefix model:kv:engine-2` — I'll coordinate with infra to avoid thundering.

Ben: I'll prepare two small smoke scripts: perf-short (2k token generation, p50/p95) and correctness-rerank (beam=4, topk checks). Quick commands:
```
# perf
./smoke/perf_short.sh --model engine:v2.11 --seq 2048 --iters 20

# correctness
./smoke/correctness_rerank.sh --model engine:v2.11 --seed 42 --cases 30
```
I'll push to the artifacts bucket and post links in the thread before window.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for channel eng-runtime at 2026-11-12T21:00:00Z (slab canary 10%). Owner: Maya (runtime). Reminder will fire 15m prior.

ops-bot: Quick checklist: :white_check_mark: Smoke owner assigned (Kevin) :white_check_mark: Rollback manifest present (Anita) :warning: KV flush coordination required (Samir). Update the runbook step if you change the widen timing. Link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/runtime-deploys

Kevin: I'll run the scripts and post perf numbers to this thread. If p95 increases > 2x or correctness fails any case, we rollback immediately.

Maya (runtime): agreed. I'll be on call during the widen. If anyone needs a hand with the rollout command sequence, ping me. :thumbsup:

Ben: Posted artifacts: s3://rw-inference/smoke/2919001234/perf_short.log and s3://rw-inference/smoke/2919001234/correctness.json

Samir: infra confirmed KV flush window locked at T+5m after canary widen to 40%. We'll coordinate to avoid spikes.

Anita: Heads-up: monitoring alerts prepped. If an alert trips, follow runbook -> collect `engine.log` and `kv-metrics` then escalate.

Maya (runtime): perfect. final checklist before 21:00 UTC: Kevin (smoke) ✅, Anita (rollback & monitoring) ✅, Samir (kv flush) ✅, Ben (scripts/artifacts) ✅. See you in the channel for the handoff.

Kevin: will post quick signal at canary ready and again at widen.

Maya (runtime): thanks team — hold on standby. :rotating_light:
